newsitem.title: CANADA: Cypress makes revised bid for Cdn Jorex.
newsitem.headline: Cypress makes revised bid for Cdn Jorex.

text.p: Cypress Energy Inc and Canadian Jorex Ltd said on Tuesday they entered into a revised agreement whereby Cypress would purchase all of the outstanding common shares of Jorex at a price of C$0.72 cash per share or 0.36 of a Cypress share for each Jorex share to a maximum of two million Cypress shares.
Jorex said its board of directors approved the offer and intends to recommend that shareholders accept the offer.
The companies said the revised offer will expire at 0200 EDT/0600 GMT September 7.

They said an additional cash payment of C$50,000 has been paid by Jorex as an inducement to make the revised offer, and Jorex agreed to pay Cypress a fee of C$0.04 per share if another take-over proposal is completed.
Jorex agreed to return the C$150,000 security deposit paid to Cypress on July 26 and grant to Cypress a security interest in the assets of Jorex to secure the payment of the break fee.

The companies said a major Jorex shareholder representing about 53.1 percent of the fully diluted outstanding shares has agreed to tender its shares to the revised offer and provide to Cypress 25 percent of any proceeds it receives from any other take-over proposal in excess of C$0.63 per Jorex share.
